name: maraudon_purple
notes: Census fixes (20261024010000). Critters: 2914 Snake, 4076 Roach, 6145 School of Fish and 13321 Frog (faction 188/190, 1 hp, type 8) are out of every pull; 37 pure critter pulls are gone and 12 mixed groups lost their critter positions. Boss-linked trash is out of the pulls: the two Putridus Shadowstalkers of 0.50 (54675/54676) and Celebras' three Corrupt Forces of Nature (13743) aggro with their boss (creature_groups flags 2/15), so the boss steps bring them. Leg 0 group 40 keeps both Cavern Lurkers of the old 0.41/0.42 as one pull: they stand 9.1 yd apart and Meshlok the Harvester (12237, rare rank 2) patrols through them; the rare is in every leg's skip list and not a member. Leg 3 group 6 is 10 units on purpose: two linked packs (5 Deep Borers + 5 Theradrim Shardlings) interleaved within 8 yd; splitting them would pull both anyway. Leg 3 groups 16/17 take the rest of their linked groups as positions (5 and 6 members). The satyr pack and the lone Shadowstalker 9.8 yd from it are one pull (leg 0 group 60), as are the Deeprot Tangler and Stomper 6.7 yd apart (leg 0 group 69). Every radius is now the group's farthest wander + 2 (5-8 yd): no row reaches a neighbouring pack (the dungeon generator's default 25 did).

Fleers: 12216 Poison Sprite (EventAI flee at 15 %). Humanoid casters: 11793/11794 (Polymorph). kill_first 12224 (Wild Regeneration at 75 %), 13142 and 12220 (roots), 12217 (Corruption); no healer among the trash.

Patrols: 29 hostile creature_movement patrols (7 Theradrim Guardians with their linked shardlings, 3 Shadowstalkers, 2 Dryads, 2 Sisters, 2 Slimes, 2 Hydras, 2 Snapjaws, 2 Stompers, one each Tangler/Behemoth/Corruptor/Lurker/Spewed Larva, and the rare Meshlok). The 80 groups whose anchors come within 25 yd of a path carry one block each (the nearest patrol); periods are estimates (path length at 2.5 yd/s). The run leader's rows carry no patrol.

Route risks no plan field fixes: 56 hostile Vile Larvae (12218, non-elite 45-47) are not in any pull (the generator left them to the orange wing) and the leg-0 approach path passes within 0.7-6 yd of seven 7-larva linked groups; friendly NPCs stand on the route: Spirit of Maraudos 12242 at 2.3 yd (leg 0), Elder Splitrock 15556 at 3.3 yd (leg 4), Celebras the Redeemed 13716 at 0.0 yd on the Celebras boss point. Princess Theradras summons 12238 on aggro (script); no door, lever or key is in the wing. The Scepter of Celebras event and the Vylestem vines are optional and not in the plan.

Still open: the rotgrip boss point needs the mapping walk (needs_walk), 11 detour groups stand on another layer than their pack (leg 0 groups 2/3/14/24/25/48/49/71, leg 2 groups 20/21, leg 3 group 6), and the run-leader hop notices remain.
